  • 日本語名: 鏖殺ノ乙女.
  • 英語名: Minagoroshi no Otome.

あらすじ

— A revenge tragedy of the black-haired noblewoman, who burns sins to ashes with black flames —

Suddenly appearing, the invaders known as “Celestial Beings” pushed humanity to the brink of extinction.

These grotesque and massive beings ignored all calls for help and brought destruction everywhere. Human cities were burned one after another, and Earth was ruthlessly ravaged. Forests were burned, fields were poisoned, and the seas became a death world covered in an oily film.

  • 英語名: Tsuki Kidou Kaisen Saisho no Tokushu Sengihei-tachi

别名

  • 魔法少女消耗戦線 DeadΩAegis外伝

あらすじ

Humanity’s first contact with aliens was far from peaceful, and now these hostile monsters from another galaxy are coming for the destruction of Earth. Every attempt to push back the advancing waves has been met with tremendous losses, as conventional weapons are practically useless against these invaders. Now in humanity’s darkest hour, there is a new beacon of hope in the form of Special Warfare Troopers, known to some as just “magical girls”.
